title: GPU LDPC belief-propagation batch decode kernel
description:
## Goal

LDPC belief-propagation batch decode kernel on gfx1030 covering
DVB-T2 n=64800 today; designed for per-`i_LS` 5G NR shift tables
so the same kernel parameterises both standards.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages for gf2-sim pipeline)
within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). May absorb in-scope work from
`epic:hip-gpu-prototype` (`806eb14e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] GPU LDPC BP hard-decision output matches CPU decoder
  for DVB-T2 n=64800 at fixed RNG state and BP algorithm
  (MinSum / NMS / SumProduct).
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: receipt records GPU batch
  decode throughput ≥ 10× single-thread CPU baseline on
  gfx1030 at deep-waterfall mean_iters.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
